podcast.body: A single from Elastica's self-titled debut album, released in January 1994, more than a year before the album itself. "A single by elastica from their self-titled debut album, the song came out in January 1994, more than a year before the album came out."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Released in late 1993, this song showcased similarities to original 1970s new wave music. Elastica's strong admiration for earlier new wave sounds led them to be sued twice for appropriating parts of old songs. "Elastica from late 1993 with Stutter, note the similarities between that song and some of the original 70s new wave."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Alt Rock Revivals Part 5: New Wave

podcast.body: This song is featured on Elastica's 1995 debut record, showcasing the band's signature sound led by Justine Frischmann. "Elastica led by Justine Friesman and that stutter from their 1995 debut record."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
